title: List the top 10 players' names whose heights are above 180 in descending or
question:
List the top 10 players' names whose heights are above 180 in descending order of average heading accuracy.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: heights are above 180 refers to Player.height > 180; average heading accuracy = DIVIDE(SUM(heading_accuracy), COUNT(player_fifa_api_id));

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
    p.XCL_125 AS player_name,
    AVG(pa.XCL_145) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa
    ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE p.XCL_127 > 180
GROUP BY p.XCL_121, p.XCL_125
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
WHERE p.XCL_126 > 180
GROUP BY p.XCL_122, p.XCL_123
ORDER BY SUM(pa.XCL_139) * 1.0 / COUNT(pa.XCL_130) DESC
LIMIT 10;
